proposal.summary: Report describes a cross-site request forgery (CSRF) against qdPM 9.2 allowing an attacker to submit a form that updates a user's account (including changing password and email) by tricking a victim into loading an attacker-hosted HTML page.
proposal.cwe_quote:
Steps to Exploit :
	1) Make an HTML file of given POC (Change UserID field Accordingly)and host it.
	2) send it to victim.
proposal.recommended_next_step: Verify the CSRF by reproducing the POST against an authenticated test account on qdPM 9.2 and confirm whether anti-CSRF tokens or SameSite cookie protections are present; if vulnerable, implement and enforce CSRF tokens and SameSite=strict/lax as appropriate and notify vendor.

evidence_quotes.claim: Exploit is a hosted HTML form that victim must load
evidence_quotes.quote: Make an HTML file of given POC (Change UserID field Accordingly)and host it.

evidence_quotes.claim: Attacker instructs to send the hosted page to victim
POC posts to the account update endpoint
